en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Hareyz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The dissimulation (Taqiyya) is a shield of Allahazwj, between Himazwj and Hisazwj creatures’.
en.sarwar: 19. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from ibn Muskan from Hariz from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Al-Taqiyyah is a shield of Allah between Allah (His punishing) and His creatures.”
